title: Query plans
explain: A query plan shows how the database intends to run your query, including whether it uses an index or scans the whole table. In PostgreSQL you read it with `EXPLAIN`, and `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` also runs the query and reports real timings. Reading plans is how you find out why something is slow.
exercise: Run EXPLAIN on a query before and after adding an index, and compare the two plans.
tip: `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` actually executes the statement. Wrap an `UPDATE` or `DELETE` in a transaction and roll back when you test it.
